name: Radio
summary: Pick exactly one option from a small mutually-exclusive set, all shown at once.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-radio> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens, so both frameworks render byte-identical pixels. Radios sharing a `name` are mutually exclusive; selecting one clears its siblings and emits a composed `change`. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: value
props.desc: The value this option contributes to the group

props.name: name
props.desc: Groups radios; one `name` = one mutually-exclusive set

whenToUse.when: exactly one from a small (2–5) mutually-exclusive set, all worth showing at once
one value from a known set of more than ~5 options — don't crowd the surface
one or more independent options that don't exclude each other

opinion.note: Pre-select a sensible default rather than leaving the group empty. Labels are sentence case and state the choice — 'Show results after each question', not 'Show Results'. Keep product nouns: Q&A, Word cloud.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, so there is a single render (no per-framework roots).
